test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 30 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Choose the correct meaning of the given idiom/phrase from the options:
"Wear your heart on your sleeve"
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Express emotions openly**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Wear your heart on your sleeve"** means to openly show your emotions or feelings to others, rather than keeping them private. (अपने भावनाओं को खुलकर व्यक्त करना) • **Example:** She wears her heart on her sleeve, so everyone knows how she feels about the situation. • In this context, the correct meaning of the idiom is **"Express emotions openly"**. (अपनी भावनाओं को खुलकर व्यक्त करना) • **Example:** He doesn’t hide his emotions; he always wears his heart on his sleeve. • Therefore, the correct answer is: **Express emotions openly**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Keep your feelings private** (अपनी भावनाओं को निजी रखना): To not share your emotions or feelings with others. • **Example:** He is a reserved person and always keeps his feelings private. • **Pretend to have emotions** (भावनाओं का दिखावा करना): To falsely display emotions that are not genuine. • **Example:** She pretended to have emotions to manipulate the situation. • **Be dishonest about your intentions** (अपनी मंशा के बारे में बेईमानी करना): To hide or misrepresent your true intentions. • **Example:** He was dishonest about his intentions, which created trust issues in the team. c9:Tcf9, सही उत्तर है: **विकल्प 3 यानी भावनाओं को खुलकर व्यक्त करना**।
